Kagylóminta (03 §4.2 E)

Abbreviations
ch – chain
dc – double crochet
sc – single crochet
sh – shell
sk – skip
st(s) – stitch(es)

Stitch key
chain (ch)
single crochet (sc)
increase (inc): 2 dc in same st
shell (sh): 5 dc in same st
increase (inc): 3 dc in same st

Kagylóminta
Foundation: ch 20.
Row 1: Starting in 2nd ch from hook, sc, [sk 2 ch, sh, sk 2 ch, sc] 3 times (19 sts). Turn.
Row 2: ch 3 (counts as 1 dc), 2 dc in same st, sk 2 sts, sc, [sk 2 sts, sh, sk 2 sts, sc] 2 times, sk 2 sts, 3 dc in next st (19 sts). Fasten off.
